dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: No matter how many times I make the journey, it always feels so far to me. In a few years, I fear my body won't be able to endure it...

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern... I can still manage for now. I'm merely venting because of my sore legs.

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: If you think about it, the transportation distance is quite reasonable when purchasing commodities in bulk from Yilong Wharf right now...

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: You transport the goods from Yilong Wharf to the docks southeast of Qiaoying Village, follow the waterway to Wangshu Inn before transferring to Liyue Harbor, then load a ship bound for Dornman Port...

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Direct land transportation through the Stone Gate is an option too, but it requires hiring too many carts. That's a hassle to manage, so water transportation is more convenient in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: I heard some amateur merchant from Mondstadt once transported goods by land the whole way through! What a madman! Just how long would it have taken him? How many dangerous areas did he have to pass through!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you introduce yourself real quick?

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Hmm, your presence... I'm sure of it. You're a big boss here on business, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you! I'm Fryslan, a tea merchant from Mondstadt, and I specialize in affordable tea leaves!

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Tea leaves from Yilong Wharf are really popular! Each time I get back to Mondstadt, I sell out within two months!

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: As such, I'm considering purchasing some high-end tea leaves. That way, the customers get to enjoy them slowly, and I get to improve my profit margins...

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm a regular here. Same seat, same tea!

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: If you're planning to start a business in Mondstadt, you're welcome to work with me!

dialogues.speaker: Fryslan
dialogues.text: Huh? It's all right, you can sit down and have a chat. We can listen to stories and watch plays together too!
